prompts.name: red
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached watercolor radial tower selector PNG to create HOVER state for the RIGHT RED CRYSTAL sector ONLY. Preserve exactly the square canvas, selector's circular geometry and position, golden/brass rim, dividers, four crystals' exact sizes and positions, and subtle rice-paper watercolor texture. Give ONLY the RIGHT sector a clearly visible but elegant warm ruby RED and coral-red translucent light wash over its parchment, and a narrow luminous red-colored edge around this one sector. This hover light must match the crystal color, with a softly lighter patch surrounding the crystal. Small light lift on the chosen crystal itself. Strong enough to read as selection at 280px display size, still gentle watercolor, no neon or wide bloom. All OTHER THREE sectors must stay completely neutral cream parchment with their crystals unchanged, not selected, no colored wash. Central hole stays genuinely alpha transparent and exterior stays genuinely alpha transparent, no background, no text, arrows, symbols, particles or extra objects. Retain original dimensions and alignment.
